name: feishu-next
description: Reusable Codex skills for common Feishu/Lark workflows powered by the official lark-cli.

interface.shortDescription: Plugin-first Feishu workflow router and skills for Codex.
interface.longDescription: Feishu Next is the plugin-first Feishu/Lark router and workflow layer for Codex. It dynamically discovers the current official lark-cli embedded skills and command help without vendoring them, routes atomic work to the runtime, enforces an evidence-first escalation protocol before any browser/UI fallback, and hands only explicitly owned stateful workflows to bundled skills for read-only document export, document asset mapping, IM chat archiving, and whiteboard edit/recovery or draw.io publishing with evidence-preserving outputs. Version 0.3.0 is runtime-validated against lark-cli 1.0.83 and source-audited against lark-cli 1.0.86 without hard-locking either version.
defaultPrompt: Use $feishu-next:feishu-workflow-router to route this Feishu/Lark task to the current lark-cli skill or Feishu Next workflow.
Use $feishu-next:feishu-whiteboard-ops to update or sync this Feishu whiteboard.
